_source: JEG-556 comment 'Bench value net of the waiver alternative' (2015-2025 history, pooled across 3 scorings x 4 league sizes for stability)
_method: No hindsight: lineups set on season-to-date PPG; held backup compared with best deeper player available that week on actual points; signed, split into insurance and upside
_units: net points per week per held player, pooled across all 12 settings

findings.qb_te_upside_zero: QB and TE upside nets to about zero in every setting; whatever a backup QB/TE might become, you can pick it up when it happens
findings.second_qb_te_worthless: Second QB/TE backups are worth about zero net of waivers
findings.rb_most_reliable: RB is the most reliable bench value (first backup +0.24 to +0.55 across settings)
findings.everything_small: Net of waivers, a bench spot is worth 0-0.5 points a week
